That and a lot of the hardware in (our) systems are running software which is never released in a non-compiled form. This is especially disturbing with technologies such as Intel Management Engine (IME). Basically an OS running on your system's CPU which you have zero control over and know nothing about what it is doing (and has access to EVERYTHING your system does).

Modern chips, wireless chips, video cards all seem to have proprietary blobs of code. You cannot see it. You cannot verify what it does or doesn't do. It cannot be made secure. When the manufacturer stops releasing updates, that's it. No updates. If it's open, people are free to optimize, tweak, plug security holes the manufacturer gives up on...

I'm tired of hardware that I only have a license to use, and never truly own, that someone else has full access to.
